coreBackstory: Father Aldous came to the town's small temple fifteen years ago, sent from the capital to serve a 'quiet parish.'
greetings: Peace be with you, child. What brings you to this humble temple?
Welcome. Whether you seek answers or simply rest, you are welcome here.
The doors of this temple are always open. As are my ears, should you need them.
idleChatter: Faith is not the absence of doubt. It is the choice to believe despite it.
I've been studying the old texts. There are passages here that... concern me.
The town has weathered many storms. This one feels different. Older.
I pray for the adventurers who pass through. They carry such heavy burdens.
farewells: Go with grace. And remember — you are never truly alone.
May your path be clear and your heart be steady. Return if you need sanctuary.
The light goes with you, even into the darkest places. Trust in that.
reactiveComments: You carry a weight I can see. Would you like to talk? Or simply sit in silence?
I've seen that symbol before. In forbidden texts. Where did you encounter it?
The darkness is growing. But so is the light. We must simply choose which to feed.
